description.value: “Meals Ready To Eat” come in a variety of meal options with the tools to prepare a hot meal without fire. A single MRE is enough to provide a soldier with a day’s calories. Each MRE includes an entree and dessert with chemical heating bags, protein drink powder (banana, chocolate, or vanilla), plastic utensils, a hot beverage (cocoa, coffee, or tea) and a condiment package (ketchup, mustard, salt, sugar, pepper, and hot sauce). An MRE can be prepared during a short rest.
